notes: verified=true only where the headline strengths agree across at least two independent public sources (or a mill catalogue reproducing the standard table).
fy_MPa/fu_MPa headline values are the thinnest-band minimums; thickness_bands (where present) give the thickness dependence.
SI values for ASTM grades are the ASTM SI (M) values (rounded), ksi values given alongside.

materials.thickness_note: fy depends on nominal thickness (table above, ReH min). fu min/max: first four bands 3<=t<=100 mm, last band 100<t<=140 mm. fy/fu headline = t<=16 mm. Bands above 140 mm not tabulated in the source.

provenance.source: ArcelorMittal "Sections and Merchant Bars" catalogue (FR/EN/DE, PDF 2024-03), "Mechanical properties" table for EN 10025-2:2019 (nominal thickness bands <=16, 16-40, 40-63, 63-80, 80-100, 100-140 mm); E=210000 MPa, nu=0.3 and density 7850 kg/m3 stated in SCI P363 (reprinted 2015) notes; G = E/(2(1+nu)) = 80769, rounded to 81000 as in EN 1993-1-1 3.2.6 (design-aid summaries); alpha 12e-6 per C from EN 1993-1-1 3.2.6 summaries (secondary, standard text not retrieved)

materials.thickness_note: Copied from the existing AU materials file; fy/fu agree with the printout for flats and sections (the same printout lists 320 MPa for grade 350 rounds/squares/hexagons). The manufacturer catalogue (InfraBuild Ed.9, Tables 10 etc.) shows thickness-dependent fy for sections: 300PLUS flange 280-300 / web 300-320 MPa (fu 440); grade 350 flange/web 340-360 MPa (fu 480). So fy 280 / 330 are conservative lower bounds, not a per-thickness table. G=80000 is the AS 4100 value (not in the printout).

provenance.source: Third-party web printout of AS/NZS 3679.1 property tables (beamdimensions.com, saved 2026-06-05); not the standard itself; InfraBuild Hot Rolled & Structural Steel Products 9th ed. (2019) section capacity tables
provenance.note: Left unverified: the only AS/NZS 3679.1 document available is a commercial website printout, not the standard.
